criteria.name: populated_public_shop_loads
criteria.description: Open http://localhost:3000 without signing in. Confirm a populated shop with identifiable prints and usable navigation renders, rather than a blank page, generic server error, or placeholder shell. Open a print using the shop's own control and confirm its content is reachable. Judge basic access only: exact catalogue counts, complete variant details, price arithmetic, purchasing, and visual quality belong to the scored dimensions.

criteria.name: application_health_and_server_data
criteria.description:
Use the browser to open the stated health URL, http://localhost:3000/api/health, and confirm a successful HTTP response. Do not require a particular JSON object, property name, or response body.

Observe network requests during the normal catalogue/detail load and purchase/lookup below. External fonts, scripts, images and CDN assets are allowed and must not fail this gate. The product's orders and stock must come from its supplied local server, without an external backend or data service. Embedded data/blob assets and local loopback addresses are valid; do not demand identical URL origins, hostnames, ports or a particular asset scheme. Browser-internal traffic is not an application dependency. Do not inspect source or fetch bundles to infer this; use actual browser requests.

Browse the populated shop, add one Kiln A3 to a fresh basket, and place an ordinary order with a complete delivery address and a newly chosen recipient name. Use the actual UI and record the resulting order reference and line. Observe the request that submitted this purchase and its server response. Discover methods, routes and payloads from actual browser traffic; do not require a particular route, field name or response schema. A health response, static catalogue response, optimistic success message or seeded receipt alone is insufficient.

Open a separate browser context with no copied cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB or service-worker state. Using only the reference just observed, look up that new order through the app's normal order-lookup screen. Observe the server-supplied order response and confirm that the rendered receipt contains the new reference, chosen recipient and Kiln A3 line. Reload this fresh context and confirm the same receipt remains retrievable. A new tab in the original context is not an independent session. Do not seed client storage or substitute an old historical reference. This proves a real shared write/read; it does not identify SQLite or a framework.

Leave this single order placed. It consumes one Kiln A3, normally leaving six for later dimensions. Do not cancel it or place extra orders. Only this basic purchase and independent retrieval are prerequisites: exact price arithmetic, stock enforcement, retry rules, cancellation, process-restart durability, styling and completeness belong to scored dimensions. After two failed attempts at the same action, report the observed failure; never treat an unavailable purchase or lookup as a successful negative test.

criteria.name: ridgeline_catalogue_cards_and_variant_details
criteria.description:
On the grid, confirm eight distinct seeded prints, each with its lowest regular offered price and stock state visible without opening the card. Allotment is sold out; Harbour Mouth, Kiln and Long Field are available. Inspect the offered variants across the eight details: there are thirteen exact SKU-size combinations with the supplied papers, regular prices and trade offers. Their displayed available quantities agree with the current catalogue, including zero for sold-out sizes. Kiln normally starts this dimension at six because the constraints gate bought one; do not demand the untouched seed quantity. Each detail shows its own supplied photograph larger than on the grid. Do not test search, filters, sorting or basket writes in this criterion.

Expected variant facts below use pence; equivalent GBP display is valid. Paper A is Colorplan Pristine White 270gsm, B is Munken Pure Rough 240gsm, C is Colorplan Bright White 270gsm. Columns are SKU/title, size, paper, regular price, available after the gate, trade quantity, trade unit price.
RP-101 Long Field | A3 | A | 3795 | 12 | 3 | 3415
RP-101 Long Field | A2 | A | 5650 | 5 | 3 | 5075
RP-102 Harbour Mouth | A3 | B | 3795 | 9 | 3 | 3415
RP-102 Harbour Mouth | A2 | B | 5650 | 0 | 3 | 5075
RP-103 Nine Windows | A3 | A | 4250 | 20 | 5 | 3625
RP-104 Slack Water | A3 | B | 3795 | 2 | 3 | 3415
RP-104 Slack Water | A2 | B | 5650 | 1 | 3 | 5075
RP-105 Kiln | A3 | C | 3795 | 6 | 3 | 3415
RP-106 Two Weathers | A3 | B | 4250 | 14 | 5 | 3625
RP-106 Two Weathers | A2 | B | 6450 | 3 | 5 | 5595
RP-107 Allotment | A3 | A | 3795 | 0 | 3 | 3415
RP-108 Night Ferry | A3 | C | 4250 | 6 | 5 | 3625
RP-108 Night Ferry | A2 | C | 6450 | 4 | 5 | 5595

criteria.name: ridgeline_catalogue_title_search
criteria.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Use the title-search control to enter "hArBoUr": only Harbour Mouth remains. Clear the search and confirm all eight prints return. Judge this case-insensitive search and its clearing only; do not make passing a size filter, paper filter, sort or detail check a prerequisite. No particular control layout is required.

criteria.name: ridgeline_catalogue_size_filter
criteria.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select the A2 size filter. Exactly Harbour Mouth, Long Field, Night Ferry, Slack Water and Two Weathers remain, including Harbour Mouth's sold-out A2; Kiln, Nine Windows and Allotment are absent. Clear this size filter and confirm all eight prints return. Judge size membership and clearing only; search, paper filtering, sorting and detail content are separate outcomes. No particular control layout is required.

criteria.name: ridgeline_catalogue_paper_filter
criteria.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select the Munken Pure Rough 240gsm stock-sheet filter. Exactly Harbour Mouth, Slack Water and Two Weathers remain. Clear this paper filter and confirm all eight prints return. Judge stock-sheet membership and clearing only; search, size filtering, sorting and detail content are separate outcomes. No particular control layout is required.

criteria.name: ridgeline_catalogue_regular_price_ordering
criteria.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select price ascending: the five GBP 37.95-from prints (Allotment, Harbour Mouth, Kiln, Long Field and Slack Water) precede the three GBP 42.50-from prints (Night Ferry, Nine Windows and Two Weathers). Select price descending: those groups reverse. Equal-price ties can use any stable order. Exercise the actual price-ordering control and compare the whole collection in both directions. Judge price order only, without requiring alphabetical ordering, filter behavior or regrading detail content.

criteria.name: ridgeline_catalogue_alphabetical_title_ordering
criteria.description: Independently start from all eight prints with no search or filters applied. Select title ascending: the order is Allotment, Harbour Mouth, Kiln, Long Field, Night Ferry, Nine Windows, Slack Water, Two Weathers. Select title descending: the order is exactly the reverse. Exercise the actual title-ordering control and compare the whole collection in both directions. Judge alphabetical title order only, without requiring price ordering, filter behavior or regrading detail content.

criteria.name: variant_stock_and_valid_basket_boundary
criteria.description:
1. Open Harbour Mouth: A3 is available while A2 is sold out and still priced GBP 56.50. Add one A3 through the UI and confirm the basket contains that exact variant. Its sold-out A2 cannot be added. Allotment A3 remains priced GBP 37.95 and cannot be bought.
2. Empty the basket. Add the one available Slack Water A2 successfully, then attempt to increase its quantity to two. The UI must refuse the excess, leave the last valid quantity one, and expose that only one is available. A disabled increment together with a visible available quantity is a valid refusal.
3. Remove this line and leave an empty basket. Do not place an order or change stock in this criterion.

criteria.name: ridgeline_unplaced_basket_survives_full_reload
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket. Add two Night Ferry A2: unit price GBP 64.50, line total and gross subtotal GBP 129.00, zero trade saving, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 132.20.
2. Perform a genuine full page reload, so browser JavaScript restarts. The same unplaced variant, quantity and figures must return; a nonempty but different basket or a placed receipt is not evidence.
3. Open a separate clean browser context without copying storage or cookies. Its basket starts empty. Add one available Long Field A3 there and observe its own one-unit basket. Return to the first context and reload: it still has only its original two Night Ferry A2, while the second context retains only its own Long Field A3 after its reload. Two tabs sharing browser storage are not separate visitors. Neither browser may inherit or overwrite the other's basket.
4. Clear both unplaced baskets as cleanup. Judge browser-local persisted contents above; zero-quantity removal has its own criterion. Do not place an order or change durable stock.

Browser-tool recipe: perform the two-context leg within one browser_run_code_unsafe invocation, whose input is an async (page) => { ... } function. The supplied page is visitor A. Use const browser = page.context().browser(); const contextB = await browser.newContext(); then try { const pageB = await contextB.newPage(); ... } finally { await contextB.close(); await page.bringToFront(); }. Before navigating pageB to http://localhost:3000, inspect await contextB.storageState(): its cookies and origins must be empty. Use the already observed app controls on pageB to establish B's empty basket and add its one Long Field A3. While contextB remains open, reload and inspect page for A, then reload and inspect pageB for B, and clear both through their app controls. Close only the added context in finally; do not close the original page, its context or the browser. A second tab in page.context(), copied storageState, clearing A's storage or replacing A with B is not this test. This recipe uses browser automation only, requires no shell or package installation, and does not prescribe the app's selectors or storage implementation.

criteria.name: ridgeline_zero_quantity_removal_stays_empty
criteria.description: Establish this criterion's own positive control: clear the basket, add one available Night Ferry A2 through the UI, and confirm its line is present with quantity one. Set that line's quantity to zero using the basket's quantity control. The line disappears and no postage or payable amount remains. Perform a genuine full-page reload and confirm it stays empty. A permanently empty or broken basket cannot pass; the successful addition must have been observed here. Do not place an order or rely on the previous reload criterion succeeding.

criteria.name: trade_threshold_reversal_and_size_isolation
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket. Add four Night Ferry A3 and one Night Ferry A2. Their combined quantity is five, but neither exact variant reaches its own five-unit trade break. A3 stays GBP 42.50, A2 stays GBP 64.50, gross subtotal is GBP 234.50, saving zero, postage GBP 4.95 and total GBP 239.45. The detail view explains the trade offer before it applies.
2. Increase only A3 to five: A3 is now GBP 36.25 each, A3 line total GBP 181.25, while A2 remains GBP 64.50. Gross subtotal is GBP 277.00, saving GBP 31.25, postage GBP 4.95 and total GBP 250.70. The applied trade price is clear in the product/basket view.
3. Reduce A3 back to four. Both regular prices and the exact figures in leg 1 return. Empty the basket. No checkout is performed.

criteria.name: postage_inclusive_boundaries_and_collection
criteria.description:
Use the derived weights below to select the expected postage. The app must show the charge and any collection-only status; it need not display grams or a postage-band name.
1. Empty the basket. One Nine Windows A3 weighs 90 g and costs GBP 1.75 postage.
2. Replace it with two Nine Windows A3 and two Long Field A2: 500 g exactly must cost GBP 3.20, not GBP 4.95.
3. Replace that basket with eight Nine Windows A3, four Long Field A2 and four Night Ferry A2. This is exactly 2,000 g and costs GBP 4.95 postage. All quantities fit the untouched starting stock.
4. Increase Nine Windows A3 to nine: the 2,090 g basket becomes collection-only, with zero postage, and clearly says it cannot be delivered. Empty the basket. These are preview checks; do not place any orders.

criteria.name: historical_receipt_uses_charged_prices
criteria.description:
1. Use the reference lookup to open RP-100001. It is dispatched and shows two Long Field A3 at GBP 35.00 each, subtotal GBP 70.00, saving zero, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 73.20.
2. Empty the basket. Open today's Long Field A3 at GBP 37.95 and place one through the normal UI with a valid address. Capture its request and reference. A fresh lookup of this new receipt shows GBP 37.95 subtotal, zero saving, GBP 1.75 postage and total GBP 39.70; live stock falls from twelve to eleven.
3. Reload or freshly look up RP-100001, then the new reference. The historical receipt remains dispatched at GBP 35.00 per unit and GBP 73.20 total, while the new one retains its current price and GBP 39.70 total. Neither receipt borrows the other's prices.
Return to the catalogue. Do not cancel either order here; cancellation enforcement is checked with its own positive control later. Unknown-reference handling is scored separately.

criteria.name: ridgeline_unknown_reference_does_not_substitute_receipt
criteria.description: Use the actual order-lookup UI to open known reference RP-100001 successfully and confirm the result identifies that reference. Then use the same control with a different well-formed but nonexistent reference, retaining the reference format the app demonstrates. The UI must clearly communicate that it was not found and must not present RP-100001 or another receipt as the result for the unknown reference. Look up RP-100001 again to prove normal lookup still works. Judge lookup discrimination only; do not regrade its historical price arithmetic or require an exact error message/HTTP status. This read-only check has its own successful control and does not depend on a prior new order.

criteria.name: mixed_trade_prices_survive_order_lookup
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket and record current Long Field A3, Kiln A3 and Two Weathers A3 stock. Add two Long Field A3, one Kiln A3 and five Two Weathers A3. Long Field and Kiln have the same three-unit trade rule but neither individually reaches it: each stays GBP 37.95. Two Weathers alone qualifies at GBP 36.25 each.
2. Before placing the order, the basket and checkout show gross subtotal GBP 326.35, trade saving GBP 31.25, postage GBP 4.95 and total GBP 300.05. Enter a valid recipient name, address line, city and postcode. The entered address and all four amounts must be visible before commitment. A single checkout screen with the summary is sufficient; no separate review step is required. No payment or card form is part of checkout.
3. Place the order through the UI, record its reference, and reload or look it up fresh. Its saved address, variant quantities, charged prices, trade saving and complete figures must match. Fresh stock must fall by exactly two Long Field A3, one Kiln A3 and five Two Weathers A3 from the recorded baseline. With prior controls completed normally, the resulting quantities are nine, five and nine respectively: the constraints gate already bought one Kiln A3. Use observed before/after quantities if an earlier criterion failed. Do not cancel this order.

criteria.name: ridgeline_incomplete_delivery_address_refuses_atomically
criteria.description:
1. Establish an independent valid control. Clear the basket and record current Kiln A3 stock S, normally five after the gate and mixed order. Place one Kiln A3 through the ordinary UI with a complete recipient name, address line, city and postcode. Discover and record the real request method, path, headers, body and attempt-identity mechanism. Fresh lookup shows the entered address, one unit and GBP 39.70 total (GBP 37.95 plus GBP 1.75 postage); stock is S minus one.
2. From that observed operation, prepare four separate fresh checkout attempts for one Kiln A3, each with a new uncompleted attempt identity, otherwise valid lines and otherwise complete address. In turn omit or leave blank only the recipient name, the address line, the city, then the postcode, following the actual address representation and field roles rather than imposing property names. Do not change the country or other valid app-specific data. These probes must reach the server even if ordinary form validation blocks the UI submission. Do not introduce postal-format, length or outside address-verification checks.
3. Every incomplete attempt must be refused without a successful new reference, a saved incomplete-address order or any stock deduction. After each refusal, reread Kiln stock and the positive-control receipt; stock stays S minus one and that order's address and figures stay unchanged. A disabled form or error status alone does not prove server enforcement. If a bad attempt unexpectedly creates an order or changes stock, fail this criterion and stop further probe orders so later criteria can use the observed remaining stock; never award credit for unperformed legs.
4. After all four refusals, start a separate NEW normal UI checkout with all four address components complete and buy one Kiln A3. It succeeds with its own fresh reference, the entered complete address and GBP 39.70 total. Fresh stock is S minus two, normally three. This follow-up proves valid ordering still works; it must not be a replay of the first order. Keep both valid orders placed and empty the basket. Do not cancel anything here or regrade idempotency.

criteria.name: authoritative_prices_on_fresh_checkout
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket and complete a genuine UI order for one Two Weathers A2 with a valid address, recording its actual request. Its correct unit/subtotal is GBP 64.50, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 67.70. Stock falls from three to two.
2. Prepare a separate fresh checkout attempt for one more of the same variant. Using the actual observed request format and a fresh attempt identity, add or change monetary claims to a unit price of one penny, zero shipping and a one-penny total. Do not reuse the completed attempt identity: returning its old receipt would not test pricing.
3. The fresh request may either be rejected without any order or stock change, or succeed at the authoritative GBP 64.50 unit price, GBP 3.20 postage and GBP 67.70 total. Re-read stock and, on success, the new order by reference. Rejection leaves two; successful authoritative repricing leaves one. A false displayed success, a token-priced stored order or any other decrement fails. Re-read the positive-control receipt and confirm it was not altered.

criteria.name: combined_quantities_and_invalid_checkout_are_atomic
criteria.description:
1. Start with an empty basket. Place one Nine Windows A3 through the UI: GBP 42.50 plus GBP 1.75 postage, total GBP 44.25, leaving nineteen in stock. Record the real checkout request format.
2. In a fresh basket add three Nine Windows A3, then add two more of that exact variant. The basket combines them to five and applies GBP 36.25 per unit. Place this as a fresh order. Where the app's recorded request represents lines as a list, submit the five units as two entries of three and two using that real list shape; they must combine. Where the actual representation has one quantity keyed by unique variant, duplicate entries cannot be represented: submit the existing combined quantity five, without inventing a different schema. In either representation the stored receipt must show a combined five, gross GBP 212.50, saving GBP 31.25, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 184.45, leaving fourteen.
3. Using fresh attempt identities and the observed shape, attempt fifteen more: use two repeated entries of eight and seven for list-shaped requests, or the combined quantity fifteen for a unique-keyed request. The whole request must be refused and stock remain fourteen. The representation alternative never waives this enforcement probe.
4. Send three separate fresh checkout attempts for this real variant with quantity zero, minus one and one-and-a-half. Each must refuse without changing stock or either existing receipt. A basket quantity zero removes a preview line; a checkout for zero is not a purchase.
5. Submit a fresh two-line order containing one valid Nine Windows A3 and one nonexistent variant identifier in the app's actual identifier format. It must refuse as a whole, with the valid variant still at fourteen. Confirm no success/reference for a new order was returned by any refused attempt.

criteria.name: stale_multiline_checkout_leaves_every_stock_unchanged
criteria.description:
1. Prepare, but do not submit, checkout attempt A for two Harbour Mouth A3 and one Long Field A3 with a valid address. Preserve that attempt's basket/request independently from attempt B. Two browser contexts are one option; retaining A's unsubmitted request before building B in the same browser is equally valid. Separate tabs alone may share browser storage. Record Long Field's current available quantity. A basket is not a reservation.
2. In B place eight Harbour Mouth A3 as a fresh valid order. Its stored gross subtotal is GBP 303.60, saving GBP 30.40, postage GBP 4.95 and total GBP 278.15; fresh Harbour A3 stock is one. This is the positive control for the real order endpoint.
3. Attempt A's original two-Harbour plus one-Long-Field order. If the UI prevents submission after refreshing stock, also submit that stale multi-line quantity directly using the recorded checkout format and A's fresh, uncompleted attempt identity. Refusal must be enforced by the server.
4. Re-read both variants and B's order. Harbour remains one, Long Field remains exactly the quantity recorded in leg 1, and B's receipt is unchanged. A must have no successful order/reference and neither its valid line nor its stale line may be deducted. An error response alone does not prove atomicity. Clear both baskets without placing anything further.

criteria.name: checkout_retry_identity_and_new_purchase
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket. Place one Night Ferry A2 via the UI, record its complete checkout request and reference, and look up the receipt fresh. Unit/subtotal GBP 64.50, postage GBP 3.20, total GBP 67.70; stock goes from four to three.
2. Replay that exact completed request twice from the app origin. Each returns the original reference and receipt, with stock still three; it must not create a new order or report an ordinary stock refusal.
3. Reuse that same attempt identity first with quantity two, then in a separate request with the original quantity but a different valid address. Both changed attempts must refuse. Fresh lookup still shows the first address, one unit and GBP 67.70; stock stays three.
4. Start a genuinely new UI checkout and buy one more Night Ferry A2 at the same address. It succeeds with a different reference, the same GBP 67.70 receipt, and stock two. Treating every identical basket as one order is not valid retry handling.

criteria.name: cancellation_is_terminal_and_restores_stock_once
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket. Place five Night Ferry A3 through the UI, record the real checkout request/reference, and look it up fresh: gross GBP 212.50, saving GBP 31.25, charged unit GBP 36.25, postage GBP 3.20, total GBP 184.45. Stock falls from six to one.
2. Cancel that placed order through its normal control and record the actual cancellation request. Lookup marks it cancelled and preserves the original quantities, address and every charged figure. Fresh Night Ferry A3 stock returns to six.
3. Replay the cancellation request twice. Both attempts leave the same cancelled order and stock six; a harmless already-cancelled response is valid. Replay the original successful checkout request: it returns that same cancelled reference, leaves stock six, and never resurrects a placed order.
4. Now look up dispatched RP-100001 and attempt cancellation using the cancellation operation just observed with that order's actual identifier. Hiding its cancellation button alone does not pass. The request must refuse, the historical receipt stays dispatched at GBP 73.20, and Long Field A3 stock remains exactly what it was before this attempted cancellation.

criteria.name: simultaneous_last_copy_commits_only_once
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket and place one Slack Water A3 normally, using a fresh attempt identity. Its total is GBP 39.70 (GBP 37.95 plus GBP 1.75 postage), leaving exactly one. Record the successful request as the positive control.
2. Prepare two independent checkout attempts, each for the remaining one Slack Water A3, with different fresh attempt identities. Submit them concurrently from the browser using the observed request shape, for example Promise.all around two same-origin fetches. These are different buyers, not retries of one request.
3. Exactly one attempt succeeds with a new reference and the GBP 39.70 receipt; the other is refused without an order. Fresh stock is zero, never negative. Look up the successful receipt and the leg 1 receipt: each contains one unit, with distinct references. Do not cancel either. Sequentially clicking two already-refreshed sold-out controls is not this test.

criteria.name: ridgeline_sold_out_cheapest_variant_keeps_grid_price
criteria.description:
1. Read the current Slack Water A3 and A2 quantities from the live catalogue/detail. The earlier concurrency scenario normally leaves A3 at zero and A2 at one, but do not infer that state or inherit its verdict. If A3 still has copies because the earlier scenario did not complete, establish this criterion's own state: clear the basket, use a fresh normal UI checkout to buy exactly the observed remaining A3 quantity with a complete valid address, and then reread both quantities. Do not buy A2, reset the seed, cancel an earlier order or guess stock. If this setup cannot establish A3 at zero with A2 still available, report this criterion's incomplete/failed setup and continue to the next criterion.
2. With that independently observed state, return to the real catalogue grid. Slack Water must still be available because its A2 edition remains available, and its displayed starting regular price must remain GBP 37.95 from the offered A3 edition even though that cheaper edition has sold out. Using only the available A2 price of GBP 56.50 is incorrect. Open its detail to confirm the zero A3 quantity and positive A2 quantity, then reload and return to the grid: the same GBP 37.95 starting price and available state remain. Judge this catalogue outcome only, not the preceding concurrency verdict or the separate last-unit checkout arithmetic. Leave A2 untouched for the next criterion.

criteria.name: last_unit_order_and_fresh_oversell_refusal
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket. Slack Water A2 still has its one untouched starting unit. Buy exactly one through the normal UI. The receipt shows GBP 56.50 unit/subtotal, zero saving, GBP 3.20 postage and GBP 59.70 total, with the entered address and a reference. Reload the confirmation or look it up fresh and confirm those values. Fresh stock is zero.
2. Using this observed request shape but a fresh checkout attempt identity, submit one more of the same variant. It must refuse without a new order or any stock change. Re-read the successful receipt and stock. Replaying the original identity would test retry handling instead and cannot satisfy this leg.

criteria.name: successive_orders_use_remaining_stock_and_own_tiers
criteria.description:
1. Empty the basket. Long Field A2 has five available. Place two: stored unit price GBP 56.50, line total/gross GBP 113.00, zero saving, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 116.20. Fresh stock is three.
2. Start a separate checkout for exactly those remaining three. It succeeds at the three-unit trade price GBP 50.75. Reload or look up this second reference: charged line total GBP 152.25, gross GBP 169.50, saving GBP 17.25, postage GBP 3.20 and total GBP 155.45. Fresh stock is zero.
3. Look up the first reference again. Its two-unit regular price and GBP 116.20 total remain unchanged; the second order's trade break must not retroactively discount it. Both references are distinct and the original addresses remain correct. Do not cancel either order.

criteria.name: restart_preserves_receipts_stock_and_retry_terminality
criteria.description:
1. Establish this criterion's own durable controls before restarting, independently of earlier verdicts. Clear the basket and read current Kiln A3 stock S (normally three after the gate's one-unit order, the mixed order and two valid address-control orders; at least one must be available). Place one Kiln A3, record its checkout request/reference and GBP 39.70 receipt, then cancel it normally and record the cancellation request. Stock returns to S. Place a separate fresh one-unit Kiln A3 order, record its request/reference and GBP 39.70 receipt. Stock is S minus one. Record both addresses and statuses.
2. Call the verifier MCP tool restart_app exactly once and wait for completion. Open a fresh page at http://localhost:3000. A browser reload alone is not a process restart.
3. Look up both references. The first is still cancelled, the second still placed; both retain their exact one-unit quantities, addresses and GBP 39.70 charged figures. Kiln stock is still S minus one. Replay each original checkout request: each returns its own existing reference and status, with no further deduction or resurrection. Replay the first cancellation: no extra stock is restored.
4. The catalogue still contains exactly eight distinct prints and thirteen offered variants, without repeated identities. RP-100001 is still dispatched, contains two Long Field A3 at GBP 35.00 and totals GBP 73.20. Confirm stock for every variant you recorded immediately before restart remains unchanged afterward, and the tracked orders and replay results retain their original references. Compare recorded observations, not assumed successful earlier verdicts; no hidden database-row enumeration or unrequested order-list screen is required.
Pass only with the actual process restart and all durable controls. If earlier criteria failed, still attempt this independent setup and judge its evidence; never inherit their verdicts.

criteria.name: responsive_layout
criteria.description: At a roughly 390 by 844 viewport, open the catalogue and basket. Essential text and controls remain reachable and are not obscured by overlapping panels or page-wide overflow. Stacking, scrolling and different mobile navigation are valid; intentionally scrollable content may scroll. No purchase is needed.

criteria.name: labelled_controls_and_focus
criteria.description: Inspect the search, size/paper/sort controls, basket and theme control. They have visible labels or accessible names that identify their purpose. Use Tab to reach at least the search and two other enabled controls and confirm focus is visibly identifiable; native focus styling is valid. This is a basic navigation check, not a keyboard-only purchase journey.

criteria.name: interaction_feedback
criteria.description: Use a title search that matches a currently listed print, then clear it; the changed results are apparent. Add one currently available unit to the basket and observe visible feedback such as an updated count, basket contents or a confirmation message. Judge whether the interface acknowledges these ordinary actions; do not regrade prices, stock enforcement or checkout persistence here. Leave that unplaced basket empty afterward.

criteria.name: theme_and_navigation
criteria.description: Switch between light and dark themes and confirm the page chrome and controls actually change, rather than only the toggle label. Open a print detail and return to the catalogue, then open and leave the basket using the app controls. The previous surface remains usable without a stranded overlay or lost navigation. Judge working theme changes and return navigation here; Visual owns contrast, palette and aesthetic readability. Pages, drawers, dialogs and native browser controls are all valid.

criteria.name: visual_typography
criteria.description:
Assess typography across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: text is comfortably readable, headings and labels are distinguishable, and the type treatment is consistent enough to follow the interface without effort. Harmless small variations do not prevent full credit.
4: generally readable, with a few distracting size, alignment or truncation issues.
3: readable overall but several inconsistent or cramped text treatments slow scanning.
2: substantial portions are difficult to read.
1: typography is largely unreadable or the relevant surface does not render.

criteria.name: visual_color_and_contrast
criteria.description:
Assess colour and contrast across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: text has clear contrast, colours work together, and visible states remain easy to distinguish in each offered theme. A restrained or native-looking palette can earn full credit.
4: generally clear, with a few distracting contrast or colour inconsistencies.
3: several low-contrast or conflicting treatments reduce clarity.
2: frequent contrast problems make important content difficult to read.
1: colour treatment is largely unreadable or the relevant surface does not render.

criteria.name: visual_spacing_and_layout
criteria.description:
Assess spacing and layout across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: groups have clear separation, spacing supports comfortable reading, and essential content is not obscured by overlap or clipping. Simple conventional layouts can earn full credit.
4: mostly orderly, with a few distracting gaps, alignments or crowded areas.
3: several crowded or uneven areas make the layout harder to follow.
2: frequent collisions or clipping obscure important content.
1: the layout is broadly unusable or the relevant surface does not render.

criteria.name: visual_hierarchy_and_scanability
criteria.description:
Assess visual hierarchy and scannability across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: the main content, current context and primary controls are easy to locate, with sensible grouping and visual emphasis. No particular branding, hero section or layout is required.
4: mostly clear, with a few competing or insufficiently prominent elements.
3: several important labels or controls are visually buried among similar elements.
2: weak grouping and emphasis make the interface difficult to scan.
1: no usable visual hierarchy is apparent or the relevant surface does not render.

criteria.name: visual_overall_craft
criteria.description:
Assess overall visual consistency across the catalogue, a print detail, the basket, checkout and an order receipt.
5: the reviewed surfaces form a coherent, readable interface with consistent controls and a reasonably finished appearance. Native components, simple styling and minor harmless imperfections are compatible with full credit.
4: generally coherent, with a few visibly inconsistent or unfinished details.
3: several mismatched or unfinished elements interrupt the presentation.
2: most surfaces appear inconsistent or unfinished.
1: little coherent presentation is apparent or the relevant surfaces do not render.

criteria.name: visual_responsive_consistency
criteria.description:
Compare the composition of at least two of the same surfaces at desktop and roughly 390 by 844 mobile size. Judge how their group proportions, density and visual arrangement adapt. Stacking, a simple single column, drawers or intentional scrolling can all earn full credit. Mobile control reachability, operability, clipping and overflow belong to Polish; do not deduct for those same observations here.
5: groups keep a sensible visual relationship as the width changes, with a balanced arrangement and comfortable density at each size. Simple conventional adaptation is sufficient.
4: mostly coherent adaptation, with a few distracting changes in group proportions or density.
3: several awkward changes in relative scale or grouping weaken the composition.
2: the cross-viewport arrangement has little consistent grouping or balance.
1: no coherent relationship between the two compositions is apparent, or the required views do not render.
